title: Multi-arg user function inside clocked process (mirrors Ring 5 q_mul/q_div/q_pow/q_ln pattern)
sourceUrl: internal: extension of 139-lfsr-through-fn to prove capstone A3/A4/A5/A7 unblock
problemDescription: 4-bit accumulator whose next-state comes from a user-declared 2-arg function `step_add(a, b)`. Same reactivity concern as capstone_calc's `q_mul(a,b)` / `q_div(a,b)` / `q_pow(a,n)` / `q_ln(a)` in fixed_point.vhd — those were flagged 'USR-FN GAP' pre-fix in Ring 5's testbench_full. Pre-fix, step_add(state, delta) would freeze at step_add(init_state, init_delta); post-fix, args re-parse against the live scope each fire so state accumulates: 0 → 3 → 6 → 9 → 12 → 15 → 2 (4-bit wrap) → 5 → 8 → 11 → 14 → 1 → …. If this case fails after --roundtrip, the DeferredUserFunction wrapper doesn't propagate correctly through Builder+Emitter for multi-arg calls.
